SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7462
Section 2, Special Branch 186661/
REPORT
Date February 10 1936.
Subject Communication from H.B.M. Consulate-General, dated January 8, 1936,
re L. Peshkovsky, Russian.
Made by D.S. Makaroff Forwarded by S.B.Rm. Dy.

Lev Arturovitch Peshkovsky-Ponsar, Russian, was born
on January 17, 1894 at Jalta, Crimea.
In 1913 having graduated from the Navigation School at
Petrograd, he was assigned to the Baltic Fleet as junior
lieutenant, where he served throughout the World War. At the
outbreak of the revolution in 1917, he joined the "white" forces
and fought against the bolsheviks on the Caspian sea and in
South Russia. After the defeat of the white Russian forces in
South Russia, he evacuated, with the rest of Russian Army, first
to Enzeli, Persia, and then to Messopotamia, where he was
interned by the British Authorities.
In 1919 he arrived in Vladivostok, Maritime Province, with
a group of former members of General Wrangel's Army, and again
took active service in the ranks of Admiral Kolchak's Army,
fighting against the bolsheviks in Siberia.
Peshkovsky-Ponsar came to Shanghai in May 1923, and for
the next two or three years lived in rather straitened circums-
tances as he was unable to secure for himself permanent
employment. However, from 1926 he obtained work on boats operated
by the various Chinese Shipping Companies, first as second
officer and later as master-mariner.
In this capacity he worked for the South China Steamship
Co., 353 Kiangse Road, for a period of four years and then
obtained employment with the North China Steamship Co., 29
Rue du Consulat. At present he is employed with the Chung Wei
Steamship Co., 110 Szechuen Road, as master-mariner, and his
boat, the s.s. Pei Hua is plying between Hongkong and Malay
Straits, having been chartered by the Far Eastern Steamship Co.,
of Hongkong. Peshkovsky is well known to a number of Russian

日期：1936年2月10日。
事由：英国驻华总领事馆1936年1月8日来函，关于俄国人 L. Peshkovsky。
由 D.S. Makaroff 撰写，经特科副主管转呈。

列夫·阿尔图罗维奇·佩什科夫斯基-庞萨尔（Lev Arturovitch Peshkovsky-Ponsar），俄国人，1894年1月17日出生于克里米亚雅尔塔。
1913年，他毕业于彼得格勒航海学校，被派往波罗的海舰队担任少尉，并在整个第一次世界大战期间服役。1917年革命爆发时，他加入“白军”，在里海和俄罗斯南部与布尔什维克作战。白俄军队在俄罗斯南部战败后，他随其余俄国军队先撤离至波斯恩泽利（Enzeli），随后撤至美索不达米亚，在那里被英国当局拘禁。
1919年，他与前弗兰格尔将军部队的一群成员一起抵达滨海省符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），再次在科尔恰克海军上将的军队中积极服役，在西伯利亚与布尔什维克作战。
佩什科夫斯基-庞萨尔于1923年5月来到上海，在接下来的两三年里，由于无法找到固定工作，他的生活相当拮据。然而，从1926年起，他在各家中国航运公司运营的船只上找到了工作，起初担任大副，后来担任船长。
在此职位上，他为位于江西路353号的华南轮船公司（South China Steamship Co.）工作了四年，随后受雇于位于领事馆路29号的华北轮船公司（North China Steamship Co.）。目前，他受雇于位于四川路110号的中威轮船公司（Chung Wei Steamship Co.），担任船长，其驾驶的“北华”轮（s.s. Pei Hua）往返于香港和马来亚海峡之间，该船已被香港的远东轮船公司（Far Eastern Steamship Co.）包租。佩什科夫斯基为上海许多俄罗斯

He is married to one Lidia Viacheslavna nee Pokrovsky, who

Peshkovsky has two brothers, one in Leningrad, and the

海员和前海军军官所熟知，被认为是一个诚实、正直的人，对政治不感兴趣，也不依附于任何政治组织。
他的妻子是莉迪亚·维亚切斯拉夫娜·佩什科夫斯卡娅（Lidia Viacheslavna nee Pokrovsky），居住在万隆路132号。
佩什科夫斯基有两个兄弟，一个在列宁格勒，另一个也是船长，据信在苏联一艘往返于列宁格勒与欧洲及英国各港口之间的船只上工作。
本局未掌握对列奥·佩什科夫斯基（Leo Peshkovsky）不利的任何情况。

N. Charong.
D. S.

副总监（特科）。
